figurative_meaning_en: A person skilled in reading difficult or illegible handwriting
similar_in_english: Able to read doctor's handwriting (humorous equivalent)
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে একজন জিতাক্ষর, পুরনো হাতের লেখা সহজেই পড়ে ফেলে।
আমাদের গ্রামের লেখক জিতাক্ষর বলে পরিচিত।
example_sentences_in_english: He is a jitakshor, easily deciphering old handwritten notes.
The village scribe is known as a jitakshor for his skill.
note: Refers to expertise in paleography-like skills in Bengali context
